description: This Java source file implements the service class 'ProvisioningCategoryWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl' which handles creation, deletion, and update operations for provisioning categories in the Apache Fineract project. It interacts with the database through a repository and performs JSON validation, exception handling, and business logic related to provisioning categories.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service class for managing provisioning categories, including creation, deletion, and update operations, with exception handling and validation.

methods.name: createProvisioningCateogry
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning category after validating JSON input and handling database integrity exceptions.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCateogry
methods.description: Deletes an existing provisioning category if it is not associated with any loan products, throwing exceptions otherwise.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing provisioning category with new data, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: isAnyLoanProductsAssociateWithThisProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Checks whether any loan products are associated with the specified provisioning category.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Internal method to handle data integrity exceptions, translating them into meaningful application exceptions.
